steps.content: You eliminate all the contorted shadow figures and set her free. You see no indication of fear on her face as she watches these ghostly creatures disappear.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: ...Did you destroy them all?

options: Yes, thankfully you are safe and sound.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: <size=31>I see... but they could have been extraterrestrial beings that rode piggyback on the Perishing Star. What a shame they're all gone now... There hasn't been any breakthrough in the research on the Perishing Star for ages. I thought my day had come...</size>

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Ah... Sorry, I digressed. Thank you, for coming back for me.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Did I... get lost again?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay. I'm lost too. Glad to see you again. I need your help.

options: Can you tell me who you are?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Me?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I'm a scholar, an astronomer.

options: I'd like to know your name.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: My name...
She lowers her head, trying hard to recall her own name, but it's not forthcoming. However, she doesn't seem confused or troubled.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: That's not important. The purpose of this operation is to unveil the truth about the Perishing Star. What they need is an astronomer. It doesn't matter what name the astronomer goes by.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Yes, the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color>.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: What a strange name that is. There isn't such a thing as a city here, not anymore.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: The Perishing Star landed in the center of the desert, and the subsequent catastrophe pushed our civilization into an era of eternal night. We have to locate the Perishing Star, unveil its dark secrets, and bring light back to humanity.
Her voice is steady when she shares her lifelong passion with you, not nervous or anxious at all. There is even a hint of a smile on her face.

options: You don't seem to be afraid of it at all. On the contrary, you sound like a little excited.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I guess I am a little excited. What scientist wouldn't? When the ultimate truth is so close at hand. I've been dreaming about it lately.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I do hope it can lift the veil of ignorance before my eyes and let me see the ultimate truth. I want to... hold it in my hand.
She looks into the distance, up at the Illusory Moon in the sky, red and ominous.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Where did it come from? What path did it take?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: We humans are insignificant before the ultimate truth, which is magnificent and all-encompassing. It is within reach now.

She takes a step forward, as if oblivious to your presence. She walks toward the Illusory Moon in a daze, as she did when you first met her. Through the red light, you catch a glimpse of the craziness in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: How did you elude our observing eyes? What tricks did you employ to get to our world?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Why did you choose this place? Why are you in my dreams? Are you toying with me? You don't think I can catch you?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Or have you... come here to tell me something?
You take her hand. She turns to look at you. She doesn't seem to recognize you at first. It's some time before she speaks again.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: It's you...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Sorry, I did it again, didn't I? The Perishing Star is very near. It's hard not to be led astray.
She is right. It's hard to stay clear-headed around here. But it seems that she is easily led astray. Can you really count on her to show you the way out?

options: Stay awake. Don't let your pursuit ruin you.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Sorry... I will try my best to resist it. Someone said, "Even if annihilation is inevitable, we shall not leave this world ignorant of the thing that has brought about the annihilation."

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I like this sentence. It's an apt description of the purpose of this expedition. Not knowing can lead to despair, whereas knowledge can bring hope.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I have you, don't I? Show me the way, my dear guide.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh, please! I'm just as lost as you. I was hoping you could help me get out of here.
She smiles and extends her hand to you.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Let's join hands then. Two lost souls... Together, we shall emerge victorious.
